entities.summary: The Royal Northern College of Music (RNCM) is a conservatoire in Manchester, England. It is one of four conservatoires associated with the Associated Board of the Royal Schools of Music. In addition to being a centre of music education, the RNCM is a busy and diverse public performance venue. Royal Northern College of Music is a educational organization in Europe, established in 1973. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
